description: Delete one application and every version under it, to clean up a test application. Exactly one exact name; refused while any of its deployments is running, and refused when it has more versions than max_versions (default 0: delete its versions first with edgegap_delete_app_version, or raise max_versions after the developer agreed). Registry images are not touched. Cannot be undone.

application.description: The exact application name to delete.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

max_versions.description: Delete only if it has at most this many versions. Default 0.

name: edgegap_delete_app
title: Delete an application and all its versions
